description: flake.lock is updated by .github/workflows/update.yml (weekly nix flake update, nix flake check, then a PR), so Renovate leaves Nix alone here, except for the container images pinned in Nix strings (customManagers).

customManagers.description: Container images pinned as `image = "<name>:<tag>@sha256:<index digest>"` in Nix modules (pclaude's privatemode-proxy).

packageRules.description: privatemode-proxy publishes a placeholder v13.37.0 tag (1970 timestamp, no labels) next to its real v1.x releases.
